WITH drug_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 'non_dhp' AS grp, 1307863 AS ingredient_id UNION ALL -- verapamil
  SELECT 'non_dhp', 1328165 UNION ALL -- diltiazem
  SELECT 'dhp', 1332418 UNION ALL -- amlodipine
  SELECT 'dhp', 1318853 UNION ALL -- nifedipine
  SELECT 'dhp', 1353776          -- felodipine
), drug_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT di.grp, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM drug_ingredients di
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = di.ingredient_id
), exposures AS (
  SELECT dc.grp, de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date, de.drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_codes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT grp,
       COUNT(*) AS exposure_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS exposed_persons,
       MIN(index_date) AS first_exposure_date,
       MAX(index_date) AS last_exposure_date
FROM exposures
GROUP BY grp
ORDER BY grp;

WITH brady_candidates AS (
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, domain_id, standard_concept
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_id IN (35211262,4149786,4169095,4171683,4262316,4088983,4138456,4142566)
), counts AS (
  SELECT 'condition_concept_id' AS field, co.condition_concept_id AS concept_id, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_candidates)
  GROUP BY co.condition_concept_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'condition_source_concept_id', co.condition_source_concept_id, COUNT(*)
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  WHERE co.condition_source_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_candidates)
  GROUP BY co.condition_source_concept_id
)
SELECT c.field, c.concept_id, bc.concept_name, bc.vocabulary_id, bc.domain_id, bc.standard_concept, c.n
FROM counts c
JOIN brady_candidates bc ON bc.concept_id = c.concept_id
ORDER BY c.field, c.n DESC;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH drug_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 'non_dhp' AS grp, 1307863 AS ingredient_id UNION ALL -- verapamil
  SELECT 'non_dhp', 1328165 UNION ALL -- diltiazem
  SELECT 'dhp', 1332418 UNION ALL -- amlodipine
  SELECT 'dhp', 1318853 UNION ALL -- nifedipine
  SELECT 'dhp', 1353776          -- felodipine
), drug_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT di.grp, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM drug_ingredients di
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = di.ingredient_id
), first_exposure AS (
  SELECT dc.grp, de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_codes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY dc.grp, de.person_id
), brady_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095 -- SNOMED Bradycardia
  UNION SELECT 4169095
  UNION SELECT 4171683
  UNION SELECT 4138456
  UNION SELECT 4142566
  UNION SELECT 4262316
  UNION SELECT 4088983
), outcome AS (
  SELECT fe.grp, fe.person_id, fe.index_date,
         MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_brady_date
  FROM first_exposure fe
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = fe.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= fe.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 61, fe.index_date)
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_codes)
  GROUP BY fe.grp, fe.person_id, fe.index_date
)
SELECT grp,
       COUNT(*) AS indexed_persons,
       SUM(CASE WHEN first_brady_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS persons_with_60d_brady_code,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN first_brady_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS decimal(10,3)) AS percent_with_60d_brady_code
FROM outcome
GROUP BY grp
ORDER BY grp;

SELECT TOP 30 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, domain_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Visit'
  AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%inpatient%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%emergency%')
ORDER BY concept_id;

WITH drug_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 'non_dhp' AS grp, 1307863 AS ingredient_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 'non_dhp', 1328165 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1332418 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1318853 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1353776
), drug_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT di.grp, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM drug_ingredients di
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = di.ingredient_id
), first_exposure AS (
  SELECT dc.grp, de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_codes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY dc.grp, de.person_id
), brady_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095
  UNION SELECT 4169095 UNION SELECT 4171683 UNION SELECT 4138456 UNION SELECT 4142566 UNION SELECT 4262316 UNION SELECT 4088983
), eligible AS (
  SELECT fe.*
  FROM first_exposure fe
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence prior
    WHERE prior.person_id = fe.person_id
      AND prior.condition_start_date < fe.index_date
      AND prior.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_codes)
  )
), outcome AS (
  SELECT e.grp, e.person_id,
         MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_brady_date
  FROM eligible e
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = e.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= e.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 61, e.index_date)
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_codes)
  GROUP BY e.grp, e.person_id
), agg AS (
  SELECT grp, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN first_brady_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events
  FROM outcome GROUP BY grp
)
SELECT grp, n AS baseline_brady_free_persons, events AS persons_with_60d_brady_code,
       CAST(100.0*events/n AS decimal(10,3)) AS percent
FROM agg
ORDER BY grp;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH drug_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 'non_dhp' AS grp, 1307863 AS ingredient_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 'non_dhp', 1328165 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1332418 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1318853 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1353776
), drug_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT di.grp, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM drug_ingredients di
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = di.ingredient_id
), first_exposure AS (
  SELECT dc.grp, de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_codes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY dc.grp, de.person_id
), brady_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095
  UNION SELECT 4169095 UNION SELECT 4171683 UNION SELECT 4138456 UNION SELECT 4142566 UNION SELECT 4262316 UNION SELECT 4088983
), eligible AS (
  SELECT fe.*
  FROM first_exposure fe
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence prior
    WHERE prior.person_id = fe.person_id
      AND prior.condition_start_date < fe.index_date
      AND prior.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_codes)
  )
), outcome AS (
  SELECT e.grp, e.person_id,
         MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_brady_date
  FROM eligible e
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = e.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= e.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 61, e.index_date)
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_codes)
  GROUP BY e.grp, e.person_id
), agg AS (
  SELECT grp, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN first_brady_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events
  FROM outcome GROUP BY grp
)
SELECT grp, n AS baseline_brady_free_persons, events AS persons_with_60d_brady_code,
       CAST(100.0*events/n AS decimal(10,3)) AS event_percent
FROM agg
ORDER BY grp;

WITH drug_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 'non_dhp' AS grp, 1307863 AS ingredient_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 'non_dhp', 1328165 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1332418 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1318853 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dhp', 1353776
), drug_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT di.grp, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM drug_ingredients di
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = di.ingredient_id
), first_exposure AS (
  SELECT dc.grp, de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_codes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY dc.grp, de.person_id
), brady_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095
  UNION SELECT 4169095 UNION SELECT 4171683 UNION SELECT 4138456 UNION SELECT 4142566 UNION SELECT 4262316 UNION SELECT 4088983
), outcome AS (
  SELECT fe.grp, fe.person_id,
         MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_inpt_brady_date
  FROM first_exposure fe
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = fe.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= fe.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 61, fe.index_date)
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_codes)
  LEFT JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo
    ON vo.visit_occurrence_id = co.visit_occurrence_id
   AND vo.visit_concept_id IN (9201,262) -- inpatient or ER+inpatient visit
  WHERE co.condition_occurrence_id IS NULL OR vo.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fe.grp, fe.person_id
), agg AS (
  SELECT grp, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN first_inpt_brady_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events
  FROM outcome GROUP BY grp
)
SELECT grp, n AS indexed_persons, events AS persons_with_60d_inpatient_brady_code,
       CAST(100.0*events/n AS decimal(10,3)) AS event_percent
FROM agg
ORDER BY grp;

WITH drug_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 'non_dhp' AS grp, 1307863 AS ingredient_id UNION ALL -- verapamil
  SELECT 'non_dhp', 1328165 UNION ALL -- diltiazem
  SELECT 'dhp', 1332418 UNION ALL -- amlodipine
  SELECT 'dhp', 1318853 UNION ALL -- nifedipine
  SELECT 'dhp', 1353776          -- felodipine
), drug_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT di.grp, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM drug_ingredients di
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = di.ingredient_id
), all_ccb_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, dc.grp, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN drug_codes dc ON dc.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
), first_ccb_date AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
  FROM all_ccb_exposures
  GROUP BY person_id
), index_cohort AS (
  SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date,
         MIN(e.grp) AS grp,
         COUNT(DISTINCT e.grp) AS groups_on_index
  FROM first_ccb_date f
  JOIN all_ccb_exposures e ON e.person_id = f.person_id AND e.index_date = f.index_date
  GROUP BY f.person_id, f.index_date
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.grp) = 1
), brady_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095 -- standard SNOMED Bradycardia descendants
  UNION SELECT 4169095 UNION SELECT 4171683 UNION SELECT 4138456 UNION SELECT 4142566 UNION SELECT 4262316 UNION SELECT 4088983
), outcomes AS (
  SELECT ic.grp, ic.person_id,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
           WHERE co.person_id = ic.person_id
             AND co.condition_start_date >= ic.index_date
             AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 61, ic.index_date)
             AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_codes)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS any_60d_brady,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
           JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON vo.visit_occurrence_id = co.visit_occurrence_id
           WHERE co.person_id = ic.person_id
             AND co.condition_start_date >= ic.index_date
             AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 61, ic.index_date)
             AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM brady_codes)
             AND vo.visit_concept_id IN (9201,262)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inpt_60d_brady
  FROM index_cohort ic
)
SELECT grp,
       COUNT(*) AS persons_first_ccb_mutually_exclusive,
       SUM(any_60d_brady) AS persons_with_any_60d_brady_code,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(any_60d_brady)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(10,3)) AS any_60d_percent,
       SUM(inpt_60d_brady) AS persons_with_inpatient_60d_brady_code,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(inpt_60d_brady)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(10,3)) AS inpatient_60d_percent
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY grp
ORDER BY grp;

content.text:
Yes. In this OMOP EHR query, non-DHP CCB users had a higher 60-day bradycardia-code rate than DHP CCB users.

Results:
- DHP CCBs: amlodipine, nifedipine, felodipine
  - 100,710 exposed persons
  - 1,441 with any bradycardia code within 60 days
  - Rate: 1.431%
- Non-DHP CCBs: verapamil, diltiazem
  - 21,294 exposed persons
  - 516 with any bradycardia code within 60 days
  - Rate: 2.423%

Approximate crude relative risk:
- 2.423 / 1.431 ≈ 1.69
- So non-DHP CCBs showed about a 69% higher crude 60-day bradycardia-code rate.

Sensitivity checks:
- Excluding anyone with prior bradycardia:
  - DHP: 783 / 97,420 = 0.804%
  - Non-DHP: 296 / 20,332 = 1.456%
  - RR ≈ 1.81
- Inpatient/ER+inpatient bradycardia-coded visits only:
  - DHP: 931 / 100,200 = 0.929%
  - Non-DHP: 405 / 21,183 = 1.912%
  - RR ≈ 2.06

Caveats: this is a crude observational comparison, not adjusted for age, comorbidity, indication, dose, concomitant beta-blockers/digoxin/antiarrhythmics, or baseline cardiovascular disease. A mutually exclusive first-CCB-index query timed out, so the reported primary analysis indexes first exposure within each drug class rather than enforcing a single first CCB class per patient.
